name: manual_8c6e33
claim: LINT-006 flags C:\\Users\\... and $HOME patterns even inside policy docs that WARN against them — use placeholder notation C:\\<user>\\... or /<user>/... in ALL docs explaining what not to do.

decisions.notes: Two separate tracked files (codex-cli-v142-dispatch.md in orama, CODEX_V142_DISPATCH_2026-06-28.md in PT) were blocked by pre-commit because they contained example Windows paths demonstrating the anti-pattern. The lint cannot distinguish 'this is a bad example' from 'this is an actual bad path'.
